subject: English
question_text: Fill in each gap with suitable words based on the information of the text. 1 5 =
stimulus: Bassanio was in love with Portia, a wealthy lady known for both her (a) ------- and wisdom. He wanted to visit her in a grand way but lacked the money. So, he asked his friend Antonio for help. Antonio had no money at hand because his ships were at (b) -------, but he promised to arrange the amount. Antonio decided to borrow the money from Shylock, a moneylender who was known for his cruelty and (c) ------- interest rates. While Antonio lent money without interest to help others, Shylock would imprison people for unpaid debts. Shylock agreed to lend the money but on a dangerous condition—if Antonio failed to repay, Shylock would cut a (d) ------- of flesh from his body. This condition was to be fulfilled within (e) ------- months. ■■■ ■■■
guide_solution: Ans. (a) beauty; (b) sea; (c) high; (d) pound; (e) three; ● st ●
